observations: Net gamma exposure is negative at the close: dealers are short gamma, so their hedging trades in the direction of price moves
Spot closed below the zero-gamma level, placing the market on the short-gamma side of the flip point
The call wall sits above spot and above the flip point, while the put wall sits just below spot
Gamma coverage of the chain is complete, so the exposure figures are not the product of a partial book
The twenty-five delta put skew is inside GaleCore's calm zone, under the threshold, with the wing trading at a modest premium to the at-the-money
The volatility index settled in the mid teens and the vol-of-vol index is moderate, so the index complex is not signalling stress
implications: With dealers short gamma, hedging flows tend to amplify rather than dampen moves, so realized volatility can run above what a long-gamma book would allow while the regime holds
A move back above the flip point would change the sign of the hedging response; until then the book reads as pro-cyclical
A calm skew alongside negative gamma is a mixed combination: hedging flows are pro-cyclical while the options market is not paying up for downside protection
The walls are reported as locations of the largest single-strike gamma on each side; this read does not assign them a role as barriers or targets for price

evidence.claim: Net GEX is negative, dealers are short gamma
Spot is below the zero-gamma level
The call wall sits above spot and above the flip point
The put wall sits just below spot
Gamma coverage of the chain is complete
The skew level semaphore is in the calm zone
The skew ratio is under the threshold that would flag it
The volatility index settled in the mid teens

limitations: Post-session read: GEX is computed at request time after the close, while the volatility and vol-of-vol indices are their afternoon settlement prints
The skew snapshot carries no GaleCore timestamp, so snapshot freshness is UNKNOWN; it reflects the moment of the request
The skew is read from an expiration roughly two months out, not from the front of the curve, so it describes the term where GaleCore measures it and not the immediate tail
GEX reflects current open interest and coverage and will shift with the next session's flow
The gamma regime is a sign classification only; the magnitude relative to total exposure is not validated, and the distance of spot from the flip point is a level reading, not a probability
The walls are argmax strikes of the gamma profile; no behavioural effect of their levels on price is claimed or validated here
No comparison with earlier sessions is made here; such comparisons are only valid through the query step
Qualitative statements are not checked for entailment by the validator; only paths, numbers and directives are
